name: design-skills
description: Claude skills for design systems and accessibility: design-system-rollout, accessible-scaling, accessibility-review. Not a library: this file pins the tools the skills' scripts use and runs their tests.

scripts.test: npm run test:rollout && npm run test:scaling && npm run test:a11y

x-tool-notes.playwright-core: Render audits and captures (design-system-rollout audit-render.mjs, accessibility-review a11y-render.mjs). Brings no browser: set PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH or CHROMIUM_PATH, or run `npx playwright install chromium`.
x-tool-notes.axe-core: The rule engine a11y-render.mjs and the accessibility review panel use when it is installed in the project being checked.
x-tool-notes.typescript: Only for reading a TypeScript design-tokens file on Node older than 22.13; newer Node strips types itself. Kept on 5.x: the scripts use its transpileModule API.
x-tool-notes.node: 18 or later. Node 22.13+ reads TypeScript token files without the typescript package.
